claim_text: On September 13, 2022, a grand jury in the District of Minnesota returned a 43-count superseding indictment in United States v. Abdiaziz Shafii Farah, Mohamed Jama Ismail, Mahad Ibrahim, Abdimajid Mohamed Nur, Said Shafii Farah, Abdiwahab Maalim Aftin, Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff, and Hayat Mohamed Nur, No. 0:22-cr-00124 (ECF 57). Count 1 charges all eight with conspiracy to commit wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. sections 371 and 1343. Counts 2-12 charge wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. section 1343, named per row (interstate emails). Count 13 charges Abdiaziz Farah, Said Farah, and Mukhtar Shariff with conspiracy to commit federal programs bribery, 18 U.S.C. section 371 (object 666(a)(2)). Counts 14-19 charge federal programs bribery, 18 U.S.C. section 666, named per row. Count 20 charges seven defendants (all except Hayat Mohamed Nur) with conspiracy to commit money laundering, 18 U.S.C. section 1956(h). Counts 21-42 charge money laundering, 18 U.S.C. section 1957, named per row. Count 43 charges Abdiaziz Farah only with a false statement in a passport application, 18 U.S.C. section 1542. Forfeiture allegations incorporate Counts 1-42 and split Counts 1-19 (proceeds, section 981) from Counts 20-42 (sections 1956/1957, section 982); Count 43 is not incorporated. These are charging allegations, not adjudicated facts. Feeding Our Future / Empire family, not HSS.
